subject: €12 Million Portrait of Picasso’s ‘Golden Muse’ Recovered from Thieves After Paris Theft

A stolen Picasso painting worth €12 million is recovered during a police raid on drug dealers in Paris. 
Evidence: Art Recovery, Crime Reporting, Cultural Heritage
#Art #Picasso

The painting, depicting Marie-Therese Walter, was stolen from a storage warehouse and recovered alongside cash and luxury goods.

The recovery was an incidental result of a drug raid, not a targeted art recovery operation.

The painting was stolen by a security guard at a storage facility and eventually ended up in the hands of suspects involved in drug trafficking.

A significant piece of cultural history has been returned to its rightful owners, preventing its potential destruction or loss.
